paragraphs.text:
The bullets have no effect! They grab at you, pulling at your 
skin. You hear the horrifying sound of your own flesh tearing. 
The last thing you see is an open mouth leering down at you, 
as you scream for blessed unconsciousness. It is … THE END. 
(431)
